question: Who among the following is appointed as new Attorney General for India in September 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**R Venkataramani.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **R Venkataramani** is appointed as the **new Attorney General** for India in **September 2022.**
 
• R Venkataramani is a **senior advocate** in the** Madras High Court** and has served as the **Additional Solicitor General of India** in the past.
 
• He has also been the** Advocate General of Tamil Nadu** and has handled several **high-profile cases** in his career.
 
• As the Attorney General for India, he will be the chief legal advisor to the government and will represent the government in** all legal matters** in the Supreme Court and other courts.
 
• The Attorney General is an **important constitutional post** in India and is appointed by the **President of India **on the advice of the Prime Minister.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **R. Venkataramani** is the **current Attorney General for India** and was appointed in **2022.**

 
 
• He is a** senior advocate** in the **Supreme Court **and has been practicing law for over 50 years.
 
 
 
• **Fali Sam Nariman** is a renowned lawyer and jurist who has served as the **Attorney General of India** from **1991 to 1993. **
 
 
• **​**He is known for his expertise in **constitutional law **and has argued several landmark cases in the Supreme Court.
 
 
 
• **Harish Salve** is a senior advocate in the Supreme Court who has also served as the **Solicitor General of India**.
 
 
• He has represented several high-profile clients in his career, including the government of India in the **Kulbhushan Jadhav case.**
 
 
 
• It is important to note that the Attorney General for India is **not a permanent post** and can change with a change in government or on the retirement of the incumbent.
